# ECOS Medicare Solutions — Nevada Medicare Enrollment

> ECOS Medicare Solutions is an independent Medicare insurance agency serving all of Nevada. Led by Darin Weidauer — a certified Gerontologist from USC's Davis School of Gerontology, MBA, 22-year USAF Veteran, Registered Social Security Analyst, and licensed independent insurance agent. Free, unbiased Medicare guidance.

## Nevada Medicare Market (2026)
- 105+ Medicare Advantage plans statewide
- 50+ plans in Clark County (Las Vegas) alone
- Average MA premium: $1.06/month
- 12 standardized Medigap plans available
- 17 counties served
- 540,000+ Nevada residents are Medicare-eligible

## Services
- Medicare Advantage (Part C) plan comparison
- Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plan comparison — Plan G and Plan N
- Medicare Part D prescription drug plan comparison
- Medicare enrollment assistance
- Medicare penalty avoidance guidance
- IRMAA education and planning
- Social Security coordination
- Veterans Medicare guidance (TRICARE, VA benefits)

## 2026 Medicare Figures
- Part B premium: $202.90/month, deductible: $283
- Part A deductible: $1,736
- Part D base premium: $38.99/month, OOP cap: $2,100
- IRMAA threshold: $109,000 individual / $218,000 joint
